title: Code-Switching In-Context Learning for Cross-Lingual Transfer of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (e.g., accuracy, exact match, COMET scores) across high-, mid-, and low-resource languages against English to measure and mitigate the English-centric 'translation barrier' in multilingual models.
Evaluating model accuracy on the Multilingual Bias Benchmark for QA (MBBQ) dataset using multiple-choice questions with ambiguous and unambiguous contexts to test cross-lingual stereotypes.
